tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels beside a shallow stream and cups both hands together to scoop water, fingers pressed close with only the yellow palm pads peeking between them as droplets fall.
tasks.camera: close-up from slightly above, hands centered
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands fully in frame, all fingers and palm pads visible, no occlusion by water stream
tasks.intent_zh: 跪在溪边双手捧水，掌垫清晰可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger holds a single round pebble between thumb and forefinger and squints at it against the light, other fingers fanned open and clearly separated, palm turned toward the camera.
tasks.camera: medium close-up, front-facing hand detail
tasks.visibility_requirement: Holding hand fully visible with all five fingers separated; supporting hand at frame edge not obscuring
tasks.intent_zh: 用拇指食指捏石对光端详，手掌展开。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger presses one palm flat against a foggy glass pane, fingers splayed wide, while the other hand wipes a clear streak through the condensation with fingertips.
tasks.camera: close-up through glass, palm toward viewer
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm print hand fully visible with pads, wiping hand's fingers visible and unblocked
tasks.intent_zh: 一掌贴雾玻璃留下掌印，另一手擦出痕迹。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger carefully threads a needle, both hands raised near the face, fingers delicately pinched with the yellow pads catching light and every digit distinctly readable.
tasks.camera: tight close-up, hands and needle only
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands in tight frame, all fingertips and pads unobstructed by each other
tasks.intent_zh: 双手举高穿针，指尖垫清晰可辨。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger forms a shadow puppet of a bird with both hands interlocked, fingers spread into wings, positioned before a warm lamp so the gesture reads clearly.
tasks.camera: side close-up with lamp glow, hands silhouetted
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands and all forming fingers visible in silhouette with pads lit
tasks.intent_zh: 双手交叠做手影鸟，指形分明。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger balances a small stack of flat stones on one upturned palm, fingers spread and steady, gazing down with concentration as the other hand hovers ready to catch.
tasks.camera: medium close-up from above, palm centered
tasks.visibility_requirement: Supporting palm fully visible beneath stones, both hands entirely in frame
tasks.intent_zh: 单手托叠石保持平衡，掌指全露。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger laces thick climbing rope between fingers, one hand pulling taut while the other grips the loose end, knuckles flexed and pads pressed against the weave.
tasks.camera: close-up angled down on both hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands and interwoven fingers visible, no rope hiding full digits
tasks.intent_zh: 双手在指间穿绕绳索，指节紧绷。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger reaches up to pluck a high berry, arm extended so the palm faces outward and all five fingers stretch upward, yellow pads fully presented to the camera.
tasks.camera: low-angle close-up on the reaching hand
tasks.visibility_requirement: Reaching hand fully visible with open palm, all fingers and pads unobstructed
tasks.intent_zh: 向上摘果，掌心外展五指伸展。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger claps chalky palms together once, dust puffing outward, both hands meeting flat with fingers aligned and pads pressed, framed mid-motion.
tasks.camera: front close-up, hands at center
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible with fingers and outer pads readable despite the clap
tasks.intent_zh: 双掌相击扬尘，指掌对齐可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger holds its own tail curled in one hand, other hand smoothing fur along it, fingers spread from thumb to pinky as pads press into the tuft.
tasks.camera: medium close-up, tail and hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible gripping and smoothing, all digits and pads unoccluded by tail
tasks.intent_zh: 一手握尾一手顺毛，五指与掌垫清楚。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger presses both palms against a warm sunlit rock face, leaning weight forward, fingers spread and claws retracted, yellow pads flattened against stone.
tasks.camera: side close-up on hands and rock
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms and all fingers visible against rock, no overlap hiding pads
tasks.intent_zh: 双掌撑在暖岩上，掌垫压平清晰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger catches a falling ripe fruit with one cupped hand, fingers curving upward and pads exposed, while the other arm is thrown back for balance.
tasks.camera: medium close-up, catching hand in focus
tasks.visibility_requirement: Catching hand fully visible with cupped fingers and pads; other hand in frame edge
tasks.intent_zh: 单手屈指接住落果，掌垫朝上。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger holds a wide magnifying glass over one open palm, studying a tiny leaf, fingers spread beneath the lens and yellow pads magnified into view.
tasks.camera: close-up above through lens
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm and all fingers visible under the glass, holding hand's digits distinct
tasks.intent_zh: 放大镜照掌心细看叶片，指垫一览无余。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger ties a ribbon around a bundle, one hand holding the knot while the other pulls the loop, fingertips flexed with pads visible between strands.
tasks.camera: medium close-up on hands and bundle
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands and all fingers visible, ribbon not fully covering any digit
tasks.intent_zh: 双手系结捆绑丝带，指垫在缝隙中露出。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger taps a small drum with alternating fingertips, both hands raised, palms facing down and fingers spread in clear rhythmic arcs captured mid-beat.
tasks.camera: front medium close-up, hands top-lit
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands in frame with all fingers and downward palm pads visible
tasks.intent_zh: 双手中指交替敲鼓，指掌向下清晰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger pours seeds from one cupped palm into another, both hands forming bowls at chest height, fingers held loosely apart so the yellow pads glow inside.
tasks.camera: close-up from slightly above
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both cupped palms visible with all fingers and interior pads unobstructed
tasks.intent_zh: 双掌捧籽对倒，掌心黄垫透亮。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger stretches one hand into a narrow crack in a fallen log to retrieve a shiny beetle, fingers squeezing together, palm pads grazing the wood.
tasks.camera: very close-up on hand and log crack
tasks.visibility_requirement: Reaching hand fully visible including all fingers and palm pads against wood
tasks.intent_zh: 手指探入木缝取甲虫，掌垫贴木可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger spins a smooth disk on one fingertip, other fingers curled except the steadying pinky, eyes following the wobble, palm pads flashing with each spin.
tasks.camera: medium close-up, disk and hand centered
tasks.visibility_requirement: Spinning hand fully visible with distinct fingers and pads; disk not hiding the palm
tasks.intent_zh: 单指旋转圆盘，其余手指与掌垫清晰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger folds a paper boat with both hands, creases pressed by thumbs along the wings, fingers spread flat and yellow pads flattened on the paper.
tasks.camera: overhead close-up on hands and paper
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands on paper, all ten fingers and pads visible from above
tasks.intent_zh: 双手折纸船，拇指压折痕掌垫外露。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger gently holds a tiny bird in both palms, cupping it with fingers laced loosely, thumbs nearly touching so the yellow pads cradle the feathers.
tasks.camera: close-up, hands and bird only
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands cupped and fully visible, fingers and inner pads unoccluded by bird
tasks.intent_zh: 双手轻捧小鸟，掌垫托着羽毛。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger knocks on a wooden door with the backs of bent fingers, other hand flat against the frame, palm pads faintly reflected in the glossy surface.
tasks.camera: side close-up on knocking hand
tasks.visibility_requirement: Knocking hand's fingers and palm fully visible; frame hand's pads shown flat-side
tasks.intent_zh: 屈指叩门，另一掌贴门框露出掌垫。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger holds a small round mirror and turns one hand this way and that, examining the yellow pads of each fingertip with visible curiosity.
tasks.camera: close-up over shoulder, hands and mirror
tasks.visibility_requirement: Examined hand fully visible with all fingertips and pads; mirror hand at edge
tasks.intent_zh: 对镜翻看指尖掌垫，指形分明。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger cracks a nut by squeezing it between both palms, elbows out, fingers spread and straining, yellow pads pressed flat against the hard shell.
tasks.camera: front close-up, hands at chest
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms and all fingers visible around the nut, pads unobstructed
tasks.intent_zh: 双掌合压坚果，指展掌垫紧贴。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger digs a shallow hollow in soft sand, one hand scooping while fingers spread wide, yellow pads shedding grains, the other hand brushes sand away.
tasks.camera: low close-up on hands in sand
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands above sand with all fingers and pads visible, no digit buried
tasks.intent_zh: 双手在沙中挖坑，五指分开掌垫露沙。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger balances a long feather across two outstretched index fingers, both hands level and steady, other fingers curled with pads facing up.
tasks.camera: side close-up, hands and feather
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands fully in frame, extended index fingers and curled finger pads visible
tasks.intent_zh: 双食指平举羽毛保持平衡，掌垫朝上。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger slides a ring onto its own finger, thumb pushing it over the knuckle, other fingers fanned wide apart with yellow pads showing between them.
tasks.camera: tight close-up on the ring hand
tasks.visibility_requirement: Ring hand fully visible with all spread fingers and pads; pushing hand's digits distinct
tasks.intent_zh: 拇指推戒上指节，其余指张开露垫。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger paints a stripe on a canvas with its fingertip, other hand steadying the easel, four fingers spread apart with yellow pads glowing wetly.
tasks.camera: medium close-up, hand and canvas
tasks.visibility_requirement: Painting hand fully visible with all fingers and pads; easel hand braced at edge
tasks.intent_zh: 指腹在画布上勾线，另手扶架掌垫湿亮。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger catches a tossed coin by clamping it between two flat palms, arms extended forward, fingers straight and pads visible above the coin's edge.
tasks.camera: front close-up, hands and coin
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both flat hands visible with straight fingers and top pads above coin
tasks.intent_zh: 双掌合夹空中硬币，指直掌垫露于币上。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger taps each fingertip to its thumb in sequence while looking down, hand raised with palm toward camera and every yellow pad clearly displayed.
tasks.camera: front close-up on the raised hand
tasks.visibility_requirement: Raised hand fully visible, all five fingertips and pads unobstructed
tasks.intent_zh: 拇指依次轻点各指尖，掌垫正对镜头。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger fans itself with a wide leaf held in one hand, wrist loose, while the other hand rests palm-open on a rock, fingers spread and pads pressed to the surface.
tasks.camera: medium shot from side, hands visible
tasks.visibility_requirement: Fanning hand's fingers visible around leaf stem; resting palm fully visible with pads
tasks.intent_zh: 一手执叶扇风，一手掌贴石面展开。
